scientific_integrity: The exact last-preference distribution is credited to Durmic et al.; independent verification is not claimed. The new classification rests on explicit adjacent-mass factorization, strict monotonicity of an elementary sequence and uniform interior asymptotics. Standalone exact checks accompany the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only independent uniform preferences and one-coin forward/backward searches with n cars and n spaces. The complete finite marginal probability law is prior work. Results on shape and fine-scale moving minimum are analytical consequences requiring new inequalities and asymptotics, with residual possibility of earlier implicit derivation.
title: Exact shape transitions and a moving trough in probabilistic parking preferences
